Definition: a conditional particle; if; by implication (interj. as a wish) would that!
BiblicalUsage: This little word carries a wish: Abraham cries out that Ishmael might live before God, Moses wishes Israel were wise enough to consider their latter end, and Isaiah wishes they had hearkened to God's commandments. In each place it is the sound of a heart longing for what might have been.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God lets His people speak their longings plainly, and the wishes of Scripture show us what He Himself desires for us.
